//: The full test's settings. Keep this file out of every repository. Every company name must start ZZ, then a space or a hyphen.

host.//: folder is the company's folder name in the workspace (zz-something), for the consultancy link.

new_account.//: Registration and the invitation each make a new person on every run. {stamp} becomes the run's date and time, and both addresses must carry it. Use addresses you can open.
new_account.name: ZZ Full Test

admin.//: Your admin address, to recognise your session. No password: you sign in yourself, in the window.

mail.//: Read-only mailbox checks through Microsoft Graph. Leave blank and every email is listed for you to check by hand.
mail.// secret: Give client_secret, or client_secret_file: the path of a file that holds it.
mail.// mailboxes: The mailboxes this app may read. Mail to name+anything@ lands in name@.
